title: Streaming response closes before the body is complete
body: The client receives only the first chunk when the producer performs a blocking call. The accepted fix was to yield small chunks from an async iterator, add a timeout around the blocking operation, and emit a heartbeat for idle periods. The proxy was closing an idle connection, not truncating the response in the application layer.
accepted_answer: Use an async iterator with bounded blocking work, small chunks, and an idle heartbeat; verify proxy timeout settings.
comments: Resolved after adding an idle heartbeat and a timeout.

title: Index changes are not visible after restart
body: The service was restarted but still answered from the previous corpus. The index path pointed to an old artifact. Re-run ingestion, verify the manifest SHA, and start the service with the new DOCINTEL_INDEX_PATH.
accepted_answer: Rebuild the index, verify the manifest SHA, and point DOCINTEL_INDEX_PATH to the new artifact.
